rows.en: The carcasses of kaijin lie discarded on the floor...
From here on, let's go together. There's a staircase at the back of this room.
So you made it here, you wretched heroes!
That was a splendid victory just now! Who'd have thought you'd defeat Gebacondor!
Now then, you'll take on my pride and joy: a giant space monster!
You're up!!
Kwaaah-kiiiiiii!!
What's this...? Isn't that just Bemstar...?
Huh? That's just a plain old Bemstar!!
Is that Bemstar...!?
Is that Bemstar...!?
Is that Bemstar...!?
Is that Bemstar...!?
What, it's just a plain Bemstar!? With all that "pride and joy" talk, I figured it'd be way cooler!
Is that Bemstar...!?
Is that Bemstar...!?
Is that Bemstar...!?
Kwaaah-kiiiiiii!!
Ugh...!! It's strong!!
It's not like the Bemstars we've fought before!?
Whoa!! What is this power...!!
It's not like the Bemstars we've fought before!?
Whoa!! What is this power...!!
It seems different from the Bemstars we've fought before!?
Whoa!! What is this power...!!
This one's... not like the Bemstars we've fought, that's for sure.
...What is this power! It's nothing like the Bemstars we've fought before.
...What is this power! It's nothing like the Bemstars we've fought before.
Nwaaah... Th-this thing's damn strong...
It's a whole different beast from the ones we fought before.
...What is this power! It's nothing like the Bemstars we've fought before.
...What is this power! It's nothing like the Bemstars we've fought before.
Whoa!! What is this power...!!
It's not like the Bemstars we've fought before!?
Fufufufufu... So you can tell the difference. Yes, this is my powered-up "Modified Bemstar"!
Powered up or modified, it makes no difference. Yapool, I won't forgive you!!
Mebium Shoooot!!
Powered up or modified, I'll be the one to take it down!!
Eat this!!!
But I can't afford to lose!!
Haaaaaaah... Seiyaaaaaaaah!!!
Powered up or modified, if a thing needs taking down, I take it down!!
Here I go!!
...No matter what the enemy is!!
I won't let you!!
Powered up...? Even if it's a kaiju, I hate the sound of that...!!
Go dooown!!
Powered up, modified, I don't give a damn!! I'm takin' you down!!
Here I go, here I go, here I gooo!!
Still, this shouldn't be an enemy we can't beat!
Go dooown!!
Still, this shouldn't be an enemy we can't beat!
This'll finish it!!
Powered up or modified, it makes no difference. I'll defeat you!!
Revolcane!!
But every attack on the Modified Bemstar was absorbed by the mouth on its belly!!
Kwaaah-kiiiiiii!!
...The Mebium Shoot got absorbed?
It's not working!? No, did it absorb it!?
...What!? This thing absorbed the attack!?
This is terrible!! Our attacks are being absorbed...
...It absorbed the attack!?
...Did it absorb the attack!?
Wh-what the hell is this thing!! It went and ate my special attack!!
It absorbs attacks...?
It absorbs attacks...?
...What!? Did it absorb the attack!?
Hahahahahaha!! No attack of any kind will work on it!!
It's that belly. If we could just shut up the mouth on its belly...
Isn't there some way...!?
Isn't there any way to beat it!
Dammit!! Isn't there any way to beat it...!!
This is bad... We've got to find some way.
Isn't there some way...!?
Isn't there some way...!?
Ain't there any damn way to beat it!!
Isn't there some way...!?
Isn't there some way...!?
What are we supposed to do!!!
Tch! ...Nothing we can do about it. We're pulling back for now!

notes.note: Rows #0.8-#0.69 and #0.72-#0.81 are party-leader variants all labelled Black RX by the extractor; tone set from content (e.g. #0.39/#0.60 Mebius, #0.9/#0.14/#0.31/#0.50/#0.51/#0.66 Momotaros-style, #0.49/#0.53 Gundam 'Go down!!', #0.57 RX). Only #0.38/#0.48/#0.56/#0.57 read as Black RX himself.
Bemstar roar is new to the corpus (no earlier English); rendered 'Kwaaah-kiiiiiii!!' and reused for #0.18/#0.59.
Contemptuous plural on 'heroes' carried as 'you wretched heroes'.
'jiman no' rendered 'pride and joy' so the mocking callback in #0.14 lands.
Yapool calling out his monster, not addressing the heroes.
Glossary label 'Bemstar (Modified)' reordered as 'Modified Bemstar' in prose; also in #0.58.
Distaste for 'powered up/remodelled' fits a cyborg Rider (RX); kept generic.
Revolcane: RX's light saber (standard English name), not in glossary.
Object rendered 'the attack' since the attacker depends on the party; 'our attacks' in #0.63.
Source is bare 'isn't there some way'; 'to beat it' added in #0.73/#0.74/#0.78 for natural English. Short '...!?' variants keep the trailing-off form.
Subject restored as 'we' (the whole party is stuck).

report: 80/80 rows. Party-leader variants #0.8-#0.81 all mislabelled Black RX; tone set from content. New Bemstar roar 'Kwaaah-kiiiiiii!!'. Revolcane not in glossary.
